title: An induction that ignores its hypothesis
title_html: An induction that ignores its hypothesis
html: Logic and Proof, Chapter 4, after its first worked induction (@fd1:exm-sum-consecutive-products), said: “A proof by induction that never uses its induction hypothesis is either not an induction or is hiding a gap.” The proof of @lem-naturals-arithmetic (c) never uses its induction hypothesis. Is it an induction, and is it hiding a gap?
